SELECT
  LEFT(o.order_id, 10) AS order_id,
  DATE_DIFF(
    'day',
    CAST(oi.shipping_limit_date AS DATE),
    CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE)
  ) AS shipping_delay_days,
  r.review_score AS review_score
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    oi_inner.order_id,
    MIN(oi_inner.shipping_limit_date) AS shipping_limit_date
  FROM order_items AS oi_inner
  WHERE oi_inner.shipping_limit_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oi_inner.order_id
) AS oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    r_inner.order_id,
    AVG(r_inner.review_score) AS review_score
  FROM order_reviews AS r_inner
  WHERE r_inner.review_score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r_inner.order_id
) AS r
  ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;
